message.content:
I don’t have access to live clock data, so I can’t give you the exact current time in New York right now.  
If you need the precise time, you can check a reliable world‑clock website, use a smartphone or computer that’s set to the “America/New York” time zone, or ask a voice assistant (e.g., Siri, Google Assistant, Alexa).  

If you’d like a quick estimate, New York is usually 4 hours behind Coordinated Universal Time (UTC‑4) during daylight‑saving time (mid‑March to early‑November) and 5 hours behind (UTC‑5) otherwise. You can subtract that offset from the current UTC time to get an approximate local time.
